snippet.title: Palefrost - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A peek at Palefrost, a survival-horror game set in a post-apocalyptic city fractured by the arrival of an eternal blizzard.
Wishlist on Steam today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4836620/

You play as David, a survivor in search of the landmark known as the Fountain. Along the way, you have to manage your temperature, conserve resources, and deal with twisted monsters that emerge from the snowy veil…
Will you be buried beneath the eternal blizzard? Or will you cheat death itself? Every bullet, every match, and every decision counts.

#survivalhorror #horrorgaming #retro
